primer: Kody Technolab Ltd (NSE: KODYTECH) operates 200+ live Odigo, Athena, and Medigo robots across India and the UAE and grew H1 FY27 sales +97% YoY to Rs 62 Cr. Yet working capital tripled to 197 days, FY26 FCF fell to -Rs 53 Cr, and consolidated OPM compressed from 35% to 19%. At Rs 1,570.90 (Rs 2,265 Cr market cap, 129x P/E), the market prices in 33.5% annual growth for ten years, leaving negative expected return versus our Rs 1,050 Base Case. Verdict: REJECTED for new capital (VALUATION, CASH_FLOW) and NOT_HELD (0 shares).
